en.headline: Haughey and Li reach Asian Games 100m freestyle final
en.dek: Siobhan Haughey posted the fastest heat time of 53.60 seconds in Nagoya, with teammate Li Sum-yiu also advancing in seventh place.
body: Hong Kong, China swimmer Siobhan Haughey posted the fastest time in the women's 100 metres freestyle heats at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Tuesday morning, booking a place in the final as she seeks to defend her title.
Racing in heat four, Haughey led from the first 50 metres and touched in 53.60 seconds. Teammate Li Sum-yiu finished third in the same heat in 55.58 seconds and advanced in seventh place overall.

Haughey already has one gold and one silver at these Games, after defending her 200 metres freestyle title on Monday and swimming in Sunday's silver-medal 4x100 metres freestyle relay. The 100 metres freestyle final is scheduled later in the Nagoya programme.

RTHK reported the heat results from the morning session. Hong Kong, China has collected multiple swimming medals at this edition of the Games, including Ian Ho's silver in the men's 50 metres freestyle on Monday.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓李芯瑤晉級亞運女子百自決賽
zh.dek: 何詩蓓在名古屋以53秒60錄得初賽最快時間，隊友李芯瑤以總成績第七晉級。
body: 港隊泳手何詩蓓周二早上在名古屋亞運女子100米自由泳初賽錄得最快時間，順利晉級決賽，尋求衛冕。
她在第四組出賽，首50米已領先，最終以53秒60觸池。同組隊友李芯瑤以55秒58得第三，總成績排第七，同樣晉級決賽。
何詩蓓本屆亞運已取得一金一銀，周一成功衛冕女子200米自由泳，周日亦參與女子4x100米自由泳接力奪銀。百米自由泳決賽稍後舉行。
港台報道了早上初賽成績。港隊本屆游泳項目已有多面獎牌入帳，包括何甄陶周一在男子50米自由泳奪得的銀牌。
